test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 10
subject: general
question: The foothill range of Himalaya is known as which of the following name?
solution:
__
 
• The foothill or the southernmost region of the Himalayas is called **Shivalik**__.
 
• The Himalayas are divided into three major regions from north to south:

 
• The Inner Himalayas or the Himadri
 
• The Lesser Himalayas or Himachal
 
• The Outer Himalayas or the Shivaliks
